summary: GitHub Copilot Student gives GitHub Education-verified students free access to Copilot's features: inline suggestions/chat with agents included (excluding third-party agents) and an allowance of GitHub AI Credits, with auto model selection only. GitHub re-evaluates eligibility monthly. This is distinct from the expired 'Student Pack 2 years' promo.
claim_steps: Get verified as a student via GitHub Education (apply to GitHub Education as a student).
Go to github.com/settings/education/benefits → 'Free GitHub developer resources for students and teachers' → Learn more.
Follow the prompts to activate Copilot Student. Approval and activation can take several days.

social_proof.title: Access GitHub Copilot for free as a student
social_proof.text: Verified students on GitHub Education get free access to Copilot's features. GitHub reevaluates your eligibility every month.

social_proof.title: Plans for GitHub Copilot
social_proof.text: Copilot Student: Free. An allowance of GitHub AI Credits. Agents included (excludes third-party agents). Auto model selection only.
